parsed_json.up: Select activity details for CHEMBL1173655 (afatinib) and all related salts identified via molecule_hierarchy parent mapping. Join the compound set through the FAQ provenance path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include canonical_smiles via LEFT JOIN compound_structures. Filter for target CHEMBL203 and IC50 bioactivities with standard_units of nM. Return all rows without deduplication. Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not limit row count.
